g.text: Boundaries generalised and approximate. Coastlines: Natural Earth.
Rainforest lies near the Equator in separate blocks (Amazon,
Congo, South-east Asia), not one continuous belt.
Savannah lies in the tropics on several continents, often between
the rainforest and drier land (Africa, South America, northern
